notes.title: Boss fight tweaks, Quality of life stuff and other fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Mouse cursor will now only be visible in menus.
[*]During gameplay, the cursor will be hidden and limited to be within the game window to prevent clicking outside of it on accident.
[*]Umbrella Knight changes:[list]
[*]More friction has been applied to her.
[*]Her jump speed has been limited so she can't zip through the other side of the arena in an instant
[/list][/list][b]Fixes:[/b][list][*]Using the snake launcher at Cloudy Sky will cause the screen to shake drastically and send the player out of bounds. This was caused by a miscalculation to Froggo's position within the programming, which has been corrected in this patch.
[/list]

notes.title: Issue related to Steam Deck and OpenGL
notes.notes:
This is an issue related to trying to launch the game on a Steam Deck
The game isn't able to properly load the OpenGL library upon starting up, which results in a crash. The reason why this happens is still unknown but a workaround been applied to prevent the crash:
The game now uses the alternative non-OpenGL rendering method if an import error was thrown at the start.

Note:
A beta branch (Pyinstaller branch) is also available now in case the default branch has issues.

notes.title: Fix an issue related to using controllers
notes.notes:
There was a crash that occurs when player enters a level or controller settings while connecting to a controller.
This happens due to the fact the game doesn't recognize some controller names and I didn't account for that while implementing this.
Now whenever using a controller that isn't recognized by the game, it will default to use the Xbox 360 controller mappings and uses text instead of glyphs to represent the button input.

notes.title: Controller Support has been added alongside other minor changes
notes.notes:
Additions:
[olist]
[*] Controller support!
[list]
[*] Controller support has been implemented
[*] Input can also be remapped once a controller is connected
[/list]
[*] A speedrun timer will now be displayed during speedrun mode:
[list]
[*] it will start counting as soon as the beginning cutscene starts
[*] it will count even during cutscenes or pause menu
[*] final time is determined after you land the last hit on the final boss
[*] as of now the timer is only used as a frame of reference and the record won't be saved in any way
[/list]
[/olist]
Input related Fixes:
[list]
[*] Arrow keys can now be mapped
[*] Control Settings can now be cancelled by clicking outside the button
[*] The layout has been rearranged to be less cramped and slightly more organised
[*] Seperated the "interaction" input for door entrance and what not from the "down" input
[*] Entering the level in the world map now uses the remappable Jump input as supposed to just the Space Key
[/list]
Other Fixes:
[list]
[*] Going to the End of the Demo on the map crashes the game
[*] 	Coin bonus animation after completing the level is now the same regardless of how much bonus you get
[*] 	Mouse position is incorrect when start the game up in full screen
[*] 	Fixed an issue where starting in speedrun mode sometimes doesn't put you at the beginning of the map
[*] 	Completing the game in speedrun mode now properly wipes the save file
[*] 	Tutorials are remade to be more simplistic
[*] 	Some dialogue changes
[/list]
Gameplay changes:
	[list]
[*] Check points can now be activated by simply walking past them
[*] 	Collecting a Gem now only register after you're grounded, but it stays collected regardless if you reached a check point or not
[/list]
Boss fight related changes:
	[list]
[*] Umbrella Knight nerfed. She now closes her umbrella immedietely after being tapped
[*] 	Lily will now always attempt to throw her broom after gaurding 10 times
[*] 	Fixed an issue where Lily was able to hit the crystals off-screen
[/list]

notes.title: Some small fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] There was a section in the witch tower level that can softlock the player, which is now changed so that wouldn't happen.
[*] Sakura Sanctuary has been renamed to Sakura Sandbox.
[*] Using a checkpoint now heals the player.
[*] The Spider enemy now slide a little longer before they recover.
[*] The silk balls thrown by the spider enemies now slide for a moment if they are thrown by a player.
[*] Damaged shoes will now be lost after a boss fight.
[*] Some changes to a few text boxes.
[/list]

notes.title: "Gem Collector" Achievement fix
notes.notes:
Originally, this achievement was intended to be unlocked after collecting all 40 gems found in each level, but due to an oversight in the programming, players were able to get this achievement when their save file completion percentage exceeds a certain number.
Now it's fixed and the game properly checks your total gem count instead of the completion percentage.

notes.title: Boss fight Difficulty adjustments
notes.notes: Nerfed the final boss so it's more doable without having to keep a distance.
